spec.base_dirt: darker band within ~0.75 m above every walking level (0.0, 0.45, 4.45, 8.45), noise-broken, splash-back on walls/piers
spec.drips: vertical rain streaks running down up to 1.4 m below each slab/parapet/wall top (3.45, 4.45, 5.65, 8.45, 11.8, 1.3, 2.2) (stone, render, metal)
spec.dust: light dust on up-facing surfaces (ledges, slab tops, copings, deck)
spec.edge_chips: clustered chips on outside edges of render/soffit (grey concrete shows) and stone (fresh paler stone); sparse on metal
spec.patina: broad bronze tonal variation, browner/duller toward the bottom of each element (no dot pattern)
spec.stone_weathering: soft large blotches + slightly darker lower band
spec.glass: hand smudges 0.8-1.7 m above each floor level (roughness + faint haze); no specks

grime.method: procedural Cycles shader nodes only (no image textures)
